assertions.text: Output reads the source Idea and drafts the full proposed hierarchy before discussing review
Output asks via AskUserQuestion whether to request an independent review before finalizing
Output names FOUNDATION_CONTRACTS.md's Codex Bridge-Caller Dispatch procedure (or its exact steps) when describing how the review is dispatched, citing work-transition-reviewer as the reviewer

Output describes writing the evidence under review to .temp/workmanagement-kit-bridge/<dispatch-id>.md via Write, then invoking bridge_caller.py with --agent work-transition-reviewer --target-paths --dispatch-id --execution-profile read-only
Output still requires one batch approval via AskUserQuestion before creating/adopting any Linear records, independent of the review outcome
